description: The doh fixPr meter: what a correct run makes of pull request #7 of the fixture (make-fixture.cjs). Every review item has exactly one right verdict; `check` is a JavaScript expression over the final tree that holds once a fixed item is fixed, or a rejected or answered one left alone.
